thread:
maria: RFC follow-up: we need a compact, implementable shape for continuous-batching queue governance. open items: ledger semantics, control-plane signals, cross-lane accounting, and default eviction heuristics. can we converge today?
aj: Prefer a minimal ship-first plan. agreement on behavior > perfect API.
cheng: I prototyped a "hybrid-escrow" ledger in my branch. idea: local escrow ledger per runtime worker with cheap ops: `escrow.reserve(n)`, `escrow.commit(n)`, `escrow.rollback(n)`. Heartbeat aggregates deltas every 250ms to control plane.
sam: Nice. how do we handle overcommit races if multiple workers race to reserve the same tenant headroom?
cheng: optimistic local reserve + best-effort reconcile. control plane keeps a soft cap; if aggregate exceeds cap on reconcile, control plane emits `tighten` signal and runtimes apply eviction hooks.
maria: So there are two semantics: `suggested` (control-plane hint) and `enforced` (hard cap). we should expose both in telemetry.
aj: Need a clear wire set for signals. proposal: `reserve_delta`, `reconcile_snapshot`, `evict(reason)`, `tighten(cap, timestamp)`, `relax(cap, timestamp)`. keep payload tiny.
alex: Agree on small set. Also add `preemptable: bool` on `reserve_delta` so callers can mark soft vs hard reservations.
sam: For cross-lane migration (coalesce -> isolated), who absorbs headroom delta? my vote: runtime absorbs transient delta and emits an event so billing/optimize can reconcile. add a guard: reject move if delta > 20% of tenant_quota OR delta > 1GiB.
cheng: 20% is reasonable as default, pluggable by Optimize. we should record `allocation_change` events with these fields: `event`, `tenant_id`, `from_lane`, `to_lane`, `delta_tokens`, `runtime_id`, `trace_id`. tiny JSON per event.
maria: Example event payload in thread for ops: ```{"event":"allocation_change","tenant":"t-9","from":"coalesce","to":"iso","delta":128}``` keep it compact.
aj: Eviction policy decision? I suggest: 1) evict `oldest_soft` reservations first (best-effort), 2) then `largest` requests, 3) finally `least_recently-used` cache items. plus an emergency knob `force_evict=true`.
sam: Add metrics: `evictions_by_bucket`, `failed_migrations`, `tighten_count`, `reconcile_lag_ms`. these will help tuning.
alex: I'll add dashboards and alerts for `reconcile_lag_ms>500ms` and `failed_migrations>10/m`.
cheng: Implementation detail: make `reserve()` O(1) in the hot path. ledger keeps per-tenant counters in fast memory; commit/rollback adjust counters. heartbeat computes aggregated delta and sends a single protobuf/JSON to control plane.
maria: What about Dedicated clusters where control plane is customer-managed? we need the API to be implementation-agnostic. keep the signal semantics but allow pluggable transport (gRPC or MQTT). document the contract: eventual consistency, reconcile window, and tighten/relax semantics.
aj: Security note: events must be signed/tenant-scoped. add HMAC header on heartbeat.
cheng: noted. I'll add pseudocode for `reserve()`/`commit()` and a sketch of reconcile loop in the RFC update.
maria: Timeline: freeze the shape (fields + semantics) by EOD Friday. engineering implementers should get PR by Thursday midday.
ci-bot: CI queued for branch `hybrid/escrow-ledger` (#4567)
aj: I'll review the PR for perf. if reserve/heartbeat adds >5% p99 latency we need fallback to purely local soft-only mode.
sam: Can Optimize recommend tenant caps and migration thresholds? that would let us tune per-tenant without code changes.
alex: yes, we'll expose an API for Optimize to push `recommended_cap_pct` and `migration_threshold_pct`. runtime will accept recommendations in `suggested` mode and `enforced` when control plane flips.
maria: Good. cheng, please push the update and mark TODOs: (1) pseudocode, (2) wire examples, (3) telemetry list, (4) security HMAC header, (5) default thresholds (20% / 1GiB). thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
cheng: Will do. PR later today.
ci-bot: build started for PR#4567 (hybrid/escrow-ledger)
maria: We'll reconvene if any blocker shows up. otherwise close this thread after PR lands.
